constraints.action: Use fidaxomicin 200 mg given twice daily for 10 days
Use fidaxomicin 200 mg given twice daily for 10 days, OR twice daily for 5 days followed by once every other day for 20 days
Use vancomycin 125 mg given 4 times daily by mouth for 10 days
Use vancomycin by mouth in a tapered and pulsed regimen

Use fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) only for patients with multiple recurrences of CDI who have failed appropriate antibiotic treatments and where appropriate screening of donor and donor fecal specimens has been performed
Use vancomycin 500 mg 4 times daily by mouth or by nasogastric tube
If ileus is present, add rectal instillation of vancomycin
Administer intravenously administered metronidazole (500 mg every 8 hours) together with oral or rectal vancomycin if ileus is present
Use metronidazole 500 mg 3 times daily by mouth for 10–14 days as an alternative for nonsevere CDI if fidaxomicin or vancomycin are unavailable
Use bezlotoxumab in patients with a history of congestive heart failure (CHF) unless the benefit outweighs the risk
Administer bezlotoxumab during concurrent standard-of-care (SOC) antibiotic therapy
